## The pattern

What should the kit label? Quote the estimate line if you can. Do not include personal data.

## Why it matters

What decision does the person make differently if they see this pattern?

## Calibration

When is this *not* a pattern? Give an example of a legitimate estimate line that looks similar but should stay "Standard."

## Source

Where did you learn this pattern? A public guide, a repair-industry document, or your own experience. Do not include a real shop's name or a real person's data.

## Fixture

Can you describe a synthetic estimate that would exercise this pattern? Do not paste a real estimate.
